# AI/ML API Documentation

## AI/ML API Documentation

- [Documentation Map](https://docs.aimlapi.com/quickstart/readme.md): Map of the AI/ML API docs: find the model for a task and open its API reference. One API key, OpenAI-compatible base URL https://api.aimlapi.com/v1.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.aimlapi.com/quickstart/simple-model.md): Make a first request to any model with the OpenAI SDK, Python requests or curl: base URL https://api.aimlapi.com/v1, header Authorization: Bearer \<AIMLAPI\_KEY>.
- [MCP](https://docs.aimlapi.com/quickstart/mcp.md): Connect Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients to AI/ML API over OAuth, with no API key to copy: discover models and run inference.
- [CLI](https://docs.aimlapi.com/quickstart/cli.md): Connect Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline, OpenClaude, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, zero or ZCode to AI/ML API with one command using the aimlapi CLI.
- [Agent setup skill](https://docs.aimlapi.com/quickstart/cli/aimlapi-setup.md): Instructions for a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline, OpenClaude, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, zero or ZCode) to install the aimlapi CLI and connect itself to AI/ML API.
- [Supported SDKs](https://docs.aimlapi.com/quickstart/supported-sdks.md): Use the OpenAI SDK (Python, JavaScript) and other SDKs with AI/ML API by setting base\_url to https://api.aimlapi.com/v1.
- [Toolbox](https://docs.aimlapi.com/quickstart/toolbox.md): Ready-made tools — web search, page extraction, screenshots, news and social data and more — callable with your AI/ML API key from agents, MCP clients and your own apps.
- [Service Endpoints](https://docs.aimlapi.com/api-references/service-endpoints.md): Account and catalogue endpoints: model list with prices, deprecations, live model speed, balance, API keys, usage and per-request logs.
- [Account Balance](https://docs.aimlapi.com/api-references/service-endpoints/account-balance.md): GET /v2/billing returns the account balance in USD; /v2/billing/detail and /v2/billing/transactions add settings and history. Header: Authorization: Bearer \<AIMLAPI\_KEY>.
- [Model Performance Metrics](https://docs.aimlapi.com/api-references/service-endpoints/model-metrics.md): GET /models/metrics, no key needed: live time to first token, tokens per second and duration per model, as p50 to p99.
- [API Key Management](https://docs.aimlapi.com/api-references/service-endpoints/api-key-management.md): Create, list, update and delete API keys with /v1/keys and a management key.
- [API Key Usage](https://docs.aimlapi.com/api-references/service-endpoints/api-key-usage.md): GET /v2/usage and /v2/usage/detail return what an API key spent over a period.
- [Usage Logs](https://docs.aimlapi.com/api-references/service-endpoints/usage-logs.md): GET /v2/logs returns one row per request with cost, tokens, status and ids for tracing.
- [Complete Model List](https://docs.aimlapi.com/api-references/service-endpoints/complete-model-list.md): GET /v1/models, no key needed: every model you can call now, with ids, aliases, endpoint types and request schemas; add include=pricing for prices.
- [Model Deprecations](https://docs.aimlapi.com/api-references/service-endpoints/model-deprecations.md): GET /v1/models/deprecations, no key needed: models that are retiring, withdrawn (404) or folded into another id, with dates and the replacement id.
